prompt: Image 1 is the exact top-down plan of a concrete skate bowl called Prado, seen straight down: the flat floor is light, the curved transition walls darken toward the rim, the mid-grey ring round it is the flat deck, the thin dark line near the bottom is a spine, and everything black is outside the bowl. Image 2 is the approved design for its graphics. Paint the bowl's surface as a flat texture that fits Image 1 exactly, straight down, no perspective, no shadows, no lighting, keeping every edge exactly where it is: a smooth pale warm cream concrete floor; a big golden-yellow sun with soft rays on the floor in the upper wide part; sweeping deep blue and teal wave bands with a few orange accents following the walls all round; the word PRADO in big rounded navy-blue letters across the middle of the floor, reading left to right, upright with the top of the image at the top; a band of glazed terracotta tiles right along the rim where the walls meet the deck; the deck ring pale grey concrete; outside the bowl plain black. Hand-painted like the background art of a Japanese animated film, clean, soft, flat matte colour.
